en.t: The Golden Pavilion came faintly into view.
The Golden Pavilion was surrounded on all sides by groves of trees,

units.source_text: 它在黑夜里纹丝不动，但绝不沉睡地耸立着，

en.t: and it stood towering in the dark night without the slightest movement, yet by no means asleep,

units.source_text: 仿佛是夜本身的护卫似的……

en.t: as though it were the guard of night itself...

units.source_text: 是啊，我不曾看见金阁犹如沉睡的寺庙那样酣睡过。

en.t: Yes, I had never seen the Golden Pavilion sleep soundly like a sleeping temple.

units.source_text: 这幢不住人的建筑物可以忘却睡眠。

en.t: This uninhabited building could forget sleep.

units.source_text: 因为居住在里面的黑暗，完全摆脱了人类的规律性。

en.t: For the darkness dwelling inside it had completely escaped the regularity of human beings.
